Eligibility for Exemption
The College of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies may waive the requirement to provide proof of English language proficiency for applicants who have completed a minimum three consecutive years of study exclusively in English. In order to be considered for exemption, the foreign college or university must be listed in the International Association of Universities' World Higher Education Database (WHED) http://www.whed.net/ as providing instruction solely in English.
Institutions can be looked up in WHED by using the search function:
A pop up box will open with additional details about the institution. Exemption will only be considered for institutions which list English as the sole language of instruction. Institutions which list multiple languages, or for which no language is listed, will not be considered for exemption.
